scope: Four threat-feed ZIP archives; static reverse engineering and upstream byte comparison. Bundled sources/data inspected and scanned. Transitive dependencies and runtime execution were not part of this review.

samples.classification: benign Rust prompt-injection and command-risk scanner
review: 59 Rust source files: CLI, hook processing, local daemon, IPC/protocol, ML, decoding, Unicode, secret/exfiltration/destructive-command parsers and tests.
Traced PreToolUse/PostToolUse/UserPromptSubmit inputs to scanning decisions, warnings and denial/approval JSON. Suspect commands are parsed using tree-sitter and pattern tables rather than executed.
Actual process execution is git diff, git remote get-url and launching its own scanner daemon; daemon traffic uses local sockets/named pipes.
Network behavior obtains Hugging Face model/tokenizer artifacts through hf-hub; token read/write supports user-supplied Hugging Face authentication.
Unsafe operations are kill(pid,0) liveness probing and memory-mapped model tensors. Attack strings are detector logic and test inputs.
Reviewed package manifests, Nix/development hooks and CI/release configuration; no concealed installer or unrelated payload.
18 Go sources and 3110 YAML rule/fixture files; reviewed lexer, condition parser, detection/modifier/aggregation logic, extractor, helpers and tests.
Only runtime foreign package is gopkg.in/yaml.v3. Conditions are parsed into data structures; strings describing attacks are not executed.
No network client, OS command execution, unsafe initialization or hidden payload in package code. Makefile invokes ordinary developer tools.
AMD64 PE AdvancedRun 1.51; Authenticode signature verified, digest matches, signer Nir Sofer.
Rizin xrefs and disassembly show token-based user/SYSTEM/TrustedInstaller process creation in 0x140002ad4.

Child-process injection in 0x140012c90 resolves CreateProcessW/GetLastError, allocates remote memory, copies code/configuration, starts and resumes a remote thread, reads results, and frees allocations. Thread helper is 0x140011fcc.
Service management at 0x1400126d0 creates NirSoftAdvancedRunService with /RunAsService and supports stopping/deleting it; remote administrator-share execution is documented.
CHM extracted using 7zz; HTML is ordinary local product help with no script/object/iframe execution. No attack commands or config bundled.
Observed capabilities align with the publisher documentation; signed utility identity is already detected.
216 PHP files, 12777 YAML data files and 9 JSON manifests/data files. PHP source facts identify all 216 files without parser errors.
Runtime parses user-agent/client headers into browser, engine, OS, version and device records using bundled lookup data.

File writes update local YAML company/device mapping data. Unserialize receives content from an injected PSR cache paired with serialize on cache writes; no direct attacker input to eval or command execution.
Composer metadata has PSR-4 autoloading and ordinary library dependencies, without install/execute scripts. No embedded PE or opaque extra payload in the member inventory.
Company.php is a vendor enum/table containing Moodle and Wireshark Foundation; these names do not make the file a Moodle stub package or Wireshark application.
